abstract.p: We present ADAPT-MTU HAI's submission to PalmX 2025, targeting Arabic cultural question answering through large language model (LLM) adaptation. We apply full fine-tuning on NileChat-3B for general cultural comprehension, and parameter-efficient LoRA-based tuning on ALLaM-7B for Islamic knowledge reasoning. Our models achieved first place in the General Culture subtask and third place in the Islamic Culture subtask. This paper outlines our methodology and results, demonstrating the effectiveness of aligning LLM fine-tuning strategies with cultural knowledge domains.
